verdict.rationale: IDE chat integration is a fair question for a coding assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only documents terminal use, Cloud Shell availability, and @gemini-cli mentions in GitHub issues and PRs; none of these is in-IDE chat. Cloud Shell is a host platform and GitHub mentions are a different surface, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can chat with the coding assistant directly inside my IDE for contextual help
